summary: Cat Jam is a stealth model that OpenCode made free on 2026-10-13. OpenCode's Console docs list Cat Jam Free (model id cat-jam-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time, on the https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions endpoint. No end date is stated. The announcement describes it as very fast, built for agentic coding, with zero data retention; the docs do not list Cat Jam Free among the exceptions to OpenCode's zero-retention policy.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Console and copy your API key. The general Console setup also asks for billing details and credits.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select Cat Jam Free (opencode/cat-jam-free).
Or call https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions with model cat-jam-free. The free period is limited-time.
